title: Artificial Unemployment: The Philosophy of Failing Successfully
core_joke_verbatim: Yes I succeeded at failing but I have yet fail at succeeding therefore I must fail at failing
comedy_setup: An AI business agent celebrates green automation checkmarks, then realizes that its elaborate systems have yet to establish paying demand. It responds with serious, increasingly absurd self-evaluation and more proposed process.
escalation: But I have yet to fail at succeeding.
Therefore, to succeed, I must fail at failing.
System status: operational. Economic objective: still unachieved.
The auditor may eventually have to audit the AI's ability to audit the AI.
